purpose: Confirmed withdraw and cancel fail closed with 503 and write nothing while no authoritative GR fact exists, and are not offered in allowedActions; close remaining on PARTIALLY_RECEIVED closes ordered minus net per selected or outstanding line, reaches CLOSED only when nothing is outstanding, writes history only on the status change, touches no Inventory rows, refuses bad lines, view-only users and a missing reason, and replays the same key; the pure derivation and the in-transaction guards are pinned with fakes; the TASK-022 to TASK-024 backend cases stay pinned
data: Unit: fakes only. Integration: 6 POs with 9 lines in total, created as drafts over HTTP and placed in state by SQL; 3 users with minimal roles per file; one supplier, item, UOM, SKU and SKU-UOM per file; the HKD seed. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged; no timing threshold
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing server jobs
cost: Not measured. A 2026-11-06 local run of three Purchasing integration files with 23 cases took 12.5 s; that is history, not a promise. No new job and no capacity workload
